groups.en: Which containers the Surroundings column lists. "Only the opened one": the one you opened by clicking it in the world or with Viewpoint's key, and the floor next to you. "Auto": that with Viewpoint's camera, everything around with the usual camera. In a car everything is always shown.
groups.ch: 「周圍」欄會列出哪些容器. 「只限開啟的」: 你在世界中點選開啟或用 Viewpoint 的按鍵開啟的那個容器, 以及你旁邊的地板. 「自動」: 使用 Viewpoint 的鏡頭時同前者, 使用一般鏡頭時列出周圍全部. 在車內時一律全部顯示.
groups.cn: “周围”栏会列出哪些容器. “仅限打开的”: 你在世界中点击打开或用 Viewpoint 的按键打开的那个容器, 以及你旁边的地板. “自动”: 使用 Viewpoint 的镜头时同前者, 使用普通镜头时列出周围全部. 在车内时总是全部显示.

groups.en: Which containers the Surroundings column lists. "Only the opened one": the one you opened by clicking it in the world or with Viewpoint's key, and the floor next to you. "Auto": that with Viewpoint's camera, everything around with the usual camera and with OldPoint's overhead camera. In a car everything is always shown.
groups.ch: 「周圍」欄會列出哪些容器. 「只限開啟的」: 你在世界中點選開啟或用 Viewpoint 的按鍵開啟的那個容器, 以及你旁邊的地板. 「自動」: 使用 Viewpoint 的鏡頭時同前者, 使用一般鏡頭與 OldPoint 的俯視鏡頭時列出周圍全部. 在車內時一律全部顯示.
groups.cn: “周围”栏会列出哪些容器. “仅限打开的”: 你在世界中点击打开或用 Viewpoint 的按键打开的那个容器, 以及你旁边的地板. “自动”: 使用 Viewpoint 的镜头时同前者, 使用普通镜头和 OldPoint 的俯视镜头时列出周围全部. 在车内时总是全部显示.

Block Spawns only stops them spawning here, so bandits that walk in, such as your allies, are left alone. Left unset, bandits follow the Zeds setting; set it to None to let bandits in where zeds are moved or removed

groups.en: When a zed is in this zone: do nothing, move them out of the zone or remove them from game. The Spawns options only deal with zeds as they spawn here, so zeds that wander in are left alone; one that wanders in and is later unloaded counts as a spawn when it loads again. Bandits following this setting are blocked from spawning instead. Note that removing will include player corpses!

groups.cn: 当僵尸在此区域内时: 无动作, 将僵尸移出区域, 或将其从游戏中移除. “生成”类选项只处理在此生成的僵尸, 因此游荡进来的僵尸不受影响; 游荡进来后被卸载的僵尸, 再次加载时算作生成. 跟随此设置的土匪则改为阻止生成. 注意: 移除将包括玩家尸体!

groups.en: You wake up with a hammering headache. After a long moment of observation, you realize the world you once knew has collapsed. Everything around has turned into soulless corpses staggering on the streets. Some of them, driven by hunger, are devouring chunks of fresh flesh... <LINE> <LINE> No matter what, you must survive first. <LINE> <LINE> The most essential thing for survival is water. Find some water to prepare for the survival journey ahead.
groups.ch: 你猛地驚醒, 頭痛如裂.愣了許久才反應過來, 你曾熟悉的世界, 已然崩塌.周遭萬物都變成了沒有靈魂的軀殼, 在街道上蹣跚遊蕩. 其中一些飢腸轆轆, 正對著新鮮血肉大快朵頤…<LINE><LINE>無論如何, 你得先活下去.<LINE><LINE>生存最關鍵的是水. 趕緊找點水, 為接下來的求生之路做好準備.
groups.cn: 你猛地惊醒, 头痛如裂.愣了许久才反应过来, 你曾熟悉的世界, 已然崩塌.周遭万物都变成了没有灵魂的躯壳, 在街道上蹒跚游荡. 其中一些饥肠辘辘, 正对着新鲜血肉大快朵颐...<LINE><LINE>无论如何, 你得先活下去.<LINE><LINE>生存最关键的是水. 赶紧找点水, 为接下来的求生之路做好准备.

Five days before the outbreak, the city police and a group of strangers came to the school to collect blood samples from all students, then took your brother and four other students away. She doesn't know anything else. <LINE> <LINE> Perhaps you need to go to the Riverside Police Department for more information.

groups.en: ...Dr. Venter and Dr. Bassler express their gratitude to you. It seems they now consider you a friend, so they share more. <LINE> <LINE> Both of them belong to an organization researching biotechnology that enhances human physical abilities, and this laboratory was provided by that organization. Since the outbreak, all support from headquarters has been disrupted, and it seems something has happened there as well. Dr. Venter and his assistant have to manage everything themselves; many things that used to rely on headquarters have now become very difficult, especially since the assistant is a woman. <LINE> <LINE> You are the first survivor they've encountered since the city was overrun by zombies, and Dr. Venter feels you are trustworthy. He hopes you can help during this time and promises worthy rewards that will greatly benefit survival. <LINE> <LINE> If you agree, talk to him again.
groups.ch: …文特博士和巴斯勒博士向你表達了謝意.看來他們現在把你當成了朋友, 所以透露了更多的資訊.<LINE><LINE>他們都隸屬於一個研究增強人體機能的生物技術組織, 這個實驗室就是該組織提供的.疫情爆發後, 總部的所有支援都中斷了, 而且總部那邊似乎也出了事.文特博士和他的助手必須自己動手處理一切;許多過去依賴總部的事情現在變得非常困難, 尤其還是個女助手.<LINE><LINE>自城市被殭屍佔領以來, 你是他們遇到的第一個倖存者, 文特博士覺得你值得信賴.他希望你能在這段時期提供一些幫助, 並承諾會有豐厚回報, 對生存大有幫助的回報.<LINE><LINE>如果你同意, 再和他談談.

groups.en: ...Dr. Venter says you arrived just in time. He has just created something very interesting. He starts pouring out a stream of technical jargon that you can't understand at all. <LINE> <LINE> You look at what he is pointing to: a golf-ball-sized mass that is moving and appears to be absorbing a small piece of flesh next to it. <LINE> <LINE> In the flood of scientific terms, you manage to catch one thing: this organism is extremely attracted to the virus the doctor recently extracted from zombies. Stunned, you ask whether it could attract zombies from all around the city. <LINE> <LINE> Both the doctor and his assistant freeze. He whispered absentmindedly... the bigger the organism grows, the wider the attraction range becomes... and its current size is already far larger than when it was first formed... <LINE> <LINE> You realize the organism must be destroyed immediately. Urge Dr. Venter to destroy the organism
groups.ch: …文特博士說你來得正是時候. 他剛剛創造了一個非常有趣的東西. 他滔滔不絕地說出一連串你完全不懂的技術術語.<LINE><LINE>你看向他指的東西 - 一個高爾夫球大小, 正在移動的團塊, 它似乎在吸收旁邊的一小塊肉.<LINE><LINE>在海量的科學術語中, 你捕捉到一個資訊: 這個有機體對博士最近從殭屍體內提取的病毒極具吸引力. 你很震驚, 同時問道, 它會不會把全城的殭屍都吸引過來.<LINE><LINE>博士和他的助手都僵住了. 他無意識地小聲說道…有機體長得越大, 吸引範圍就越廣…而它現在的體積已經遠超剛形成的時候了…<LINE><LINE>你意識到必須立刻摧毀這個有機體. 催促文特博士摧毀這個有機體.
groups.cn: ...Venter博士说你来得正是时候.他刚刚创造了一个非常有趣的东西.他滔滔不绝地说出一连串你完全不懂的技术术语.<LINE><LINE>你看向他指的东西- 一个高尔夫球大小, 正在移动的团块, 它似乎在吸收旁边的一小块肉.<LINE><LINE>在海量的科学术语中, 你捕捉到一个信息: 这个有机体对博士最近从丧尸体内提取的病毒极具吸引力.你很震惊, 同时问道, 它会不会把全城的丧尸都吸引过来.<LINE><LINE>博士和他的助手都僵住了.他无意识地小声说道...有机体长得越大, 吸引范围就越广...而它现在的体积已经远超刚形成的时候了...<LINE><LINE>你意识到必须立刻摧毁这个有机体.催促Venter博士摧毁这个有机体.

groups.en: ...Dr. Venter says you arrived just in time. He has just created something very interesting. He starts pouring out a stream of technical jargon that you can’t understand at all. <LINE> <LINE> You look at what he points to — a golf-ball-sized mass that is moving and appears to be absorbing a small piece of flesh next to it. <LINE> <LINE> In the flood of scientific terms, you manage to catch one thing: this organism is extremely attracted to the virus the doctor recently extracted from zombies. Stunned, you ask whether it could attract zombies from all around the city. <LINE> <LINE> Both the doctor and his assistant freeze. He whispered unconsciously... the bigger the organism grows, the wider the attraction range becomes... and its current size is already far larger than when it was first formed... <LINE> <LINE> You realize the organism must be destroyed immediately. Let urge Dr. Venter to destroy the organism
groups.ch: …文特博士說你來得正是時候. 他剛剛創造了一個非常有趣的東西. 他滔滔不絕地說出一連串你完全不懂的技術術語.<LINE><LINE>你看向他指的東西 - 一個高爾夫球大小, 正在移動的團塊, 它似乎在吸收旁邊的一小塊肉.<LINE><LINE>在海量的科學術語中, 你捕捉到一個資訊: 這個有機體對博士最近從殭屍體內提取的病毒極具吸引力. 你很震驚, 同時問道, 它會不會把全城的殭屍都吸引過來.<LINE><LINE>博士和他的助手都僵住了. 他無意識地小聲說道…有機體長得越大, 吸引範圍就越廣…而它現在的體積已經遠超剛形成的時候了…<LINE><LINE>你意識到必須立刻摧毀這個有機體. 催促文特博士摧毀這個有機體.

groups.en: ...From the note Dr. Venter left behind, you learn that he and his assistant have moved to another, safer location. He carefully marked the place so you could find it without difficulty.
groups.ch: …從文特博士留下的字條得知, 他和助手已轉移到另一處更安全的地點. 他仔細標出了位置, 讓你能輕易找到.
groups.cn: ...从Venter博士留下的字条得知, 他和助手已转移到另一处更安全的地点. 他仔细标出了位置, 让你能轻易找到.

groups.en: ...Additional missions will be added depending on feedback about the mod...
groups.ch: …之後會依據大家對本模組的回饋, 加入更多任務…
groups.cn: ...之后会根据大家对本模组的反馈, 添加更多任务...

groups.en: ...through the conversation, you learn that the man is Dr. Venter, the owner of this laboratory. <LINE> <LINE> You ask about your brother, but he shakes his head, saying he has never seen anyone matching your description. Instead, he is worried because his assistant went out to gather food more than a day ago and has yet to return. She would normally be back within a day. He hopes you can help find her. Dr. Venter believes she is likely still wandering around food stores in the town, as she mentioned there was still plenty of food left somewhere nearby.
groups.ch: …透過交談得知, 這個男人是文特博士, 該實驗室的主人.<LINE><LINE>你問到弟弟的情況, 但他搖搖頭, 說根本沒見過你說的人.相反, 由於他助手一天多前出去搜尋食物, 至今未歸, 讓他憂心忡忡- 她通常一天內就會回來.所以他希望你能幫忙找到她.文特博士認為她很可能還在城鎮的食物店附近, 因為她提到那附近某處還有很多食物.

groups.en: ...through the conversation, you learn that she is Dr. Bassler, Dr. Venter's assistant. While searching for food, she accidentally made a loud noise, attracting too many zombies and forcing her to hide here until they dispersed. <LINE> <LINE> You ask about your brother, but Dr. Bassler has no clues at all. Before leaving, she thanks you. The area has become much safer, and says she will return to the laboratory immediately.
groups.ch: …透過交談得知, 她是巴斯勒博士, 文特博士的助手.她之所以被迫躲在這裡, 是因為之前尋找食物時, 不小心弄出了很大聲響, 引來了太多殭屍.現在只能等那些殭屍離開.<LINE><LINE>你向巴斯勒博士問起弟弟的情況, 她說根本沒有任何線索.離開前, 她向你表示感謝, 因為這裡已經安全多了- 並表示她會立即回到實驗室.

groups.en: ...Dr. Venter and Dr. Bassler express their gratitude to you. It seems they now consider you a friend, so they share more. <LINE> <LINE> Both of them belong to an organization researching biotechnology that enhances human physical abilities, and this laboratory was provided by that organization. Since the outbreak, all support from headquarters has been disrupted, and it seems something has happened there as well. Dr. Venter and his assistant have to manage everything themselves; many things that used to rely on headquarters have now become very difficult, especially since the assistant is a woman. <LINE> <LINE> You are the first survivor they've encountered since the city was overrun by zombies, and Dr. Venter feels you are trustworthy. He hopes you can help during this time and promises worthy rewards that will greatly benefit survival. <LINE> <LINE> If you agree, talk to him again.
groups.ch: …文特博士和巴斯勒博士向你表達了謝意.看來他們現在把你當成了朋友, 所以透露了更多的資訊.<LINE><LINE>他們都隸屬於一個研究增強人體機能的生物技術組織, 這個實驗室就是該組織提供的.疫情爆發後, 總部的所有支援都中斷了, 而且總部那邊似乎也出了事.文特博士和他的助手必須自己動手處理一切;許多過去依賴總部的事情現在變得非常困難, 尤其還是個女助手.<LINE><LINE>自城市被殭屍佔領以來, 你是他們遇到的第一個倖存者, 文特博士覺得你值得信賴.他希望你能在這段時期提供一些幫助, 並承諾會有豐厚回報, 對生存大有幫助的回報.<LINE><LINE>如果你同意, 再和他談談.
groups.cn: ...Venter博士和Bassler博士向你表达了谢意.看来他们现在把你当成了朋友, 所以透漏了更多的信息.<LINE><LINE>他们都隶属于一个研究增强人体机能的生物技术组织, 这个实验室就是该组织提供的.疫情爆发后, 总部的所有支持都中断了, 而且总部那边似乎也出了事.Venter博士和他的助手必须自己动手处理一切;许多过去依赖总部的事情现在变得非常困难, 尤其还是个女助手.<LINE><LINE>自城市被丧尸占领以来, 你是他们遇到的第一个幸存者, Venter博士觉得你值得信赖.他希望你能在这段时期提供一些帮助, 并承诺会有丰厚回报, 对生存大有帮助的回报.<LINE><LINE>如果你同意, 再和他谈谈.

groups.en: ...Dr. Venter thanks you for the drinking water you brought. Now, food and water are sufficient for a long time. He asks for your help with research related to the zombies. <LINE> <LINE> Dr. Venter asks you to collect 15 blood samples from zombies. He also gives you the tools and detailed instructions on how to draw blood. <LINE> <LINE> Hint: You need an Empty Syringe to collect a Blood Sample from a zombie's corpse. Each zombie can only be sampled once.
groups.ch: …你帶來了飲用水, 文特博士向你表示感謝.現在, 食物和水足夠維持很長時間了.他請求你協助進行與殭屍相關的研究.<LINE><LINE>文特博士需要你收集15份殭屍的血液樣本.並給了你工具和詳細的採血說明.<LINE><LINE>提示: 你需要一個空注射器來從殭屍屍體上採集血液樣本.每隻殭屍只能取樣一次.
groups.cn: ...你带来了饮用水, Venter博士向你表示感谢.现在, 食物和水足够维持很长时间了.他请求你协助进行与丧尸相关的研究.<LINE><LINE>Venter博士需要你收集15份丧尸的血液样本.并给了你工具和详细的采血说明.<LINE><LINE>提示: 你需要一个空注射器来从丧尸尸体上采集血液样本.每只丧尸只能采样一次.

groups.en: ...After receiving the samples, Dr. Venter no longer maintains the polite tone. He gives you a vial of serum and says it enhances the body's strength, a result of a previous research project. It has almost no side effects. <LINE> <LINE> The doctor hopes it will help you, his friend. Then he continues burying himself in his research.
groups.ch: …收到樣本後, 文特博士的語氣也不再客套.他直接給了你一小瓶血清, 說這個東西能增強身體力量, 是之前一個研究專案的成果.幾乎沒有任何副作用.<LINE><LINE>博士希望這能幫到他的朋友- 你.然後繼續埋頭於研究之中.

groups.en: ...Dr. Venter agrees immediately, without hesitation. The alcohol makes the conversation more open. <LINE> <LINE> You share your burdens, and the doctor also confides about himself. <LINE> <LINE> He was once the Chief Researcher at NMB Research Facility No. 20. Because of disagreements with colleagues, he left. As soon as he left, a man invited him to join the HGA organization and promised a private lab with everything he needed. He only cared about research, so he agreed and was brought here along with his female assistant whom he treats like a daughter. <LINE> <LINE> Here, he almost succeeded in creating a serum that comprehensively enhances human physical abilities. But because it is a synthetic serum, it caused many severe side effects, and a suitable subject resistant to all of them was required to complete it. Since no suitable subject had been found, the project had to be suspended. <LINE> <LINE> Until the zombies appeared, opening a new horizon in his research...
groups.ch: …文特博士毫不猶豫, 立刻同意了.確實是酒後吐真言.<LINE><LINE>你說了自己的煩惱, 博士也聊了他的情況.<LINE><LINE>他曾是第20號NMB研究所的首席研究員.由於和同事意見不合, 他便離開了.剛離開不久, 有個男人就邀請他加入HGA組織, 並承諾提供一間私人實驗室, 同時提供他所需的所有實驗設備.他只關心研究, 所以就答應了, 並和他視如己出的女助手一起被帶到了這裡.<LINE><LINE>在這裡, 他幾乎成功創造了一種能全面增強人類體能的血清.但由於該血清為合成血清, 所以附帶多種嚴重的副作用, 因此需要一個能抵抗所有副作用的合適實驗體才能完成研究.由於一直沒找到合適的實驗體, 該專案被迫中止.<LINE><LINE>直到殭屍出現, 為他的研究開啟了全新的契機…

groups.en: ...Dr. Venter says you arrived just in time. He has just created something very interesting. He starts pouring out a stream of technical jargon that you can't understand at all. <LINE> <LINE> You look at what he is pointing to: a golf-ball-sized mass that is moving and appears to be absorbing a small piece of flesh next to it. <LINE> <LINE> In the flood of scientific terms, you manage to catch one thing: this organism is extremely attracted to the virus the doctor recently extracted from zombies. Stunned, you ask whether it could attract zombies from all around the city. <LINE> <LINE> Both the doctor and his assistant freeze. He whispered absentmindedly... the bigger the organism grows, the wider the attraction range becomes... and its current size is already far larger than when it was first formed... <LINE> <LINE> You realize the organism must be destroyed immediately. Urge Dr. Venter to destroy the organism
groups.ch: …文特博士說你來得正是時候.他剛剛創造了一個非常有趣的東西.他滔滔不絕地說出一連串你完全不懂的技術術語.<LINE><LINE>你看向他指的東西- 一個高爾夫球大小, 正在移動的團塊, 它似乎在吸收旁邊的一小塊肉.<LINE><LINE>在海量的科學術語中, 你捕捉到一個資訊: 這個有機體對博士最近從殭屍體內提取的病毒極具吸引力.你很震驚, 同時問道, 它會不會把全城的殭屍都吸引過來.<LINE><LINE>博士和他的助手都僵住了.他無意識地小聲說道…有機體長得越大, 吸引範圍就越廣…而它現在的體積已經遠超剛形成的時候了…<LINE><LINE>你意識到必須立刻摧毀這個有機體.催促文特博士摧毀這個有機體.

groups.en: Increases your chance of hitting a target with bows and crossbows, and of doing extra damage.
groups.ch: 提高你用弓和弩命中目標以及造成額外傷害的機率.
groups.cn: 提高你用弓和弩命中目标以及造成额外伤害的概率.

groups.en: The ability to use bows accurately and efficiently.
groups.ch: 精準且有效率地使用弓的能力.
groups.cn: 精准且高效地使用弓的能力.

groups.en: Increases your chance of hitting a target with bows and crossbows, of doing extra damage, and extends their effective range.
groups.ch: 提高你用弓和弩命中目標以及造成額外傷害的機率, 並延長其有效射程.
groups.cn: 提高你用弓和弩命中目标以及造成额外伤害的概率, 并延长其有效射程.

groups.en: Shooting and making bows and arrows. A faster draw, a steadier aim, quicker nocking and fewer broken arrows.
groups.ch: 射箭以及製作弓與箭. 拉弓更快、瞄準更穩、搭箭更快, 箭矢也更不容易折斷.
groups.cn: 射箭以及制作弓和箭. 拉弓更快、瞄准更稳、搭箭更快, 箭矢也更不容易折断.

groups.en: Determines your ability to pick locks on doors and vehicles. Improves with practice.
groups.ch: 決定你撬開門鎖與車鎖的能力. 會隨著練習提升.
groups.cn: 决定你撬开门锁和车锁的能力. 会随着练习提升.

groups.en: Your proficiency in unlocking locks without a key.
groups.ch: 玩家在沒有鑰匙的情況下, 強行撬鎖的熟練程度.
groups.cn: 玩家在没有钥匙的情况下, 强行撬锁的熟练程度.

groups.en: Skill at manipulating pin-tumbler locks with improvised tools. Higher levels widen the pick's sweet spot, reduce wear on bobby pins, and grant access to tougher locks.
groups.ch: 用簡易工具操作彈子鎖的技巧. 等級越高, 撬鎖的最佳位置範圍越寬, 髮夾的磨損越少, 也能撬開更難的鎖.
groups.cn: 用简易工具操作弹子锁的技巧. 等级越高, 撬锁的最佳位置范围越宽, 发夹的磨损越少, 也能撬开更难的锁.

groups.en: Skill at picking locks on doors and vehicles. Higher levels make the minigame easier and reduce the chance of snapping a lockpick.
groups.ch: 撬開門鎖與車鎖的技巧. 等級越高, 小遊戲越容易, 撬鎖工具折斷的機率也越低.
groups.cn: 撬开门锁和车锁的技巧. 等级越高, 小游戏越容易, 撬锁工具折断的几率也越低.

groups.en: Increases damage when fighting with martial arts hand wraps. Experience is earned by landing strikes.
groups.ch: 提高使用武術纏手帶戰鬥時的傷害. 透過成功擊中目標獲取經驗.
groups.cn: 提高使用武术缠手带战斗时的伤害. 通过成功击中目标获取经验.

groups.en: Improves combat techniques used by supported martial-arts styles. Experience is earned by landing damaging strikes.
groups.ch: 強化支援的武術流派所用的戰鬥技巧. 透過擊中目標並造成傷害獲取經驗.
groups.cn: 强化受支持的武术流派所用的战斗技巧. 通过击中目标并造成伤害获取经验.

groups.en: Raises attack speed and damage with every martial arts style, and lowers the stamina each strike costs. <LINE> Each style also has a hidden mastery (5 levels) that grows as you land hits with it and unlocks longer combinations and heavy attacks. Right-click the ground > Martial Arts (or press K) to see your mastery and unlocks.
groups.ch: 提高所有武術流派的攻擊速度與傷害, 並降低每次出招消耗的耐力. <LINE> 每個流派另有隱藏精通度 (5 級), 用該流派擊中目標時會成長, 並解鎖更長的連段與重擊. 右鍵點選地面 > 武術 (或按 K) 可檢視你的精通度與解鎖內容.
groups.cn: 提高所有武术流派的攻击速度和伤害, 并降低每次出招消耗的耐力. <LINE> 每个流派还有隐藏的精通度 (5 级), 用该流派击中目标时会提升, 并解锁更长的连招和重击. 右键点击地面 > 武术 (或按 K) 可查看你的精通度和解锁内容.

groups.en: Increases damage when fighting with martial arts hand wraps. Experience is earned by landing strikes.
groups.ch: 提高使用武術纏手帶戰鬥時的傷害. 透過成功擊中目標獲取經驗.

groups.en: Minimum blood percentage required for regeneration to work. <LINE> <LINE> HOW IT WORKS: <LINE> - Below this threshold, your body is too weak to regenerate <LINE> - You MUST use blood transfusions to get above this level <LINE> - Simulates critical blood loss requiring medical intervention <LINE> <LINE> EXAMPLE (30% default, 5000 mL max): <LINE> - Below 1500 mL = NO natural regeneration <LINE> - Need transfusion to reach 1500+ mL first <LINE> <LINE> Lower = more forgiving, Higher = more realistic/hardcore.
groups.ch: 再生生效所需的最低血液百分比. <LINE> <LINE> 運作方式: <LINE>-低於此門檻值時, 身體過於虛弱無法再生 <LINE>-必須使用輸血才能恢復到該水準以上 <LINE>-模擬需要醫療介入的危急失血 <LINE> <LINE> 範例 (預設 30%%, 最大 5000 毫升): <LINE>-低於 1500 毫升=無法自然再生 <LINE>-需要先輸血至 1500+毫升 <LINE> <LINE> 較低=更寬容, 較高=更真實/硬核.
groups.cn: 再生生效所需的最低血液百分比. <LINE> <LINE> 运作方式: <LINE> -低于此阈值时, 身体过于虚弱无法再生 <LINE> -必须使用输血才能恢复到该水平以上 <LINE> -模拟需要医疗干预的危重失血 <LINE> <LINE> 示例 (默认 30%%, 最大5000毫升): <LINE> -低于1500毫升=无法自然再生 <LINE> -需要先输血至1500+毫升 <LINE> <LINE> 较低=更宽容, 较高=更真实/硬核.

groups.en: Enables custom body temperature tracking with gradual effects. <LINE> <LINE> FEATURES: <LINE> - Tracks body temperature in Celsius (37C = normal) <LINE> - Gradual cooling/warming based on environment <LINE> - Pre-disease effects (shivering, sweating) <LINE> - Smooth transition to hypothermia/heat exhaustion <LINE> <LINE> When disabled: <LINE> - Falls back to exposure-time-based disease triggering <LINE> - Vanilla temperature system is NOT suppressed <LINE> - Allows other temperature mods to work (e.g. Realistic Temps)

groups.cn: 启用自定义体温追踪, 具有渐进效果. <LINE> <LINE> 功能: <LINE> -以 °C追踪体温 (37°C=正常) <LINE> -根据环境逐渐降温/升温 <LINE> -疾病前效果 (颤抖, 出汗) <LINE> -平滑过渡到失温/热衰竭 <LINE> <LINE> 禁用时: <LINE> -回退到基于暴露时间的疾病触发 <LINE> -不会抑制原版温度系统 <LINE> -允许其他温度模组工作 (例如 Realistic Temps)

groups.en: Hot weather + exertion + dehydration causes heat exhaustion. Can progress to LETHAL heat stroke. Get shade and water!
groups.ch: 炎熱天氣+勞累+脫水導致熱衰竭. 可能發展為致命的中暑. 尋找陰涼處和水!
groups.cn: 炎热天气+劳累+脱水导致热衰竭. 可能发展为致命的中暑. 寻找阴凉处和水!

groups.en: Hot weather builds heat exhaustion exposure. At High exposure, heat stroke checks occur every 5 game minutes; 100%% exposure guarantees heat stroke.
groups.ch: 炎熱天氣會累積熱衰竭暴露值. 暴露值達到「高」時, 每 5 遊戲分鐘進行一次中暑判定; 暴露值達 100%% 必定中暑.
groups.cn: 炎热天气会累积热衰竭暴露值. 暴露值达到“高”时, 每 5 游戏分钟进行一次中暑判定; 暴露值达 100%% 必定中暑.

groups.en: Extreme cold + wet exposure causes hypothermia. LETHAL - cardiac arrest risk.
groups.ch: 極寒+受潮導致失溫症. 致命-有心跳停止風險.
groups.cn: 极寒+受潮导致失温症. 致命-有心搏骤停风险.
groups._note: CH 陸用語: 心搏驟停→心跳停止 (cardiac arrest 台灣常用說法)

groups.en: Low core body temperature causes hypothermia while the Body Temperature System is enabled. LETHAL - cardiac arrest risk.
groups.ch: 啟用體溫系統時, 核心體溫過低會導致失溫症. 致命-有心跳停止風險.
groups.cn: 启用体温系统时, 核心体温过低会导致失温症. 致命-有心搏骤停风险.

groups.en: The only weight setting. Every item is multiplied by it - every item, from a nail to a fridge, including items from other mods. At 0.10 things weigh a tenth of normal, so your grid fills up long before you get encumbered while heavy things stay heavier than light ones. 0.01 is near-weightless. 1.0 turns it off and gives you vanilla weights. This never changes how many slots anything takes: footprints always come from the item's original weight.
groups.ch: 唯一的重量設定. 每件物品的重量都會乘上此值——每一件, 從釘子到冰箱, 包括其他模組的物品. 設為 0.10 時物品重量只有正常的十分之一, 因此網格早在你超重之前就會塞滿, 而重的東西仍比輕的東西重. 0.01 幾乎沒有重量. 1.0 會關閉此功能, 恢復原版重量. 此設定永遠不會改變物品佔用的格數: 佔用尺寸一律依物品的原始重量計算.
groups.cn: 唯一的重量设置. 每件物品的重量都会乘以此值——每一件, 从钉子到冰箱, 包括其他模组的物品. 设为 0.10 时物品重量只有正常的十分之一, 因此在你超重之前网格早就会被塞满, 而重的东西仍比轻的东西重. 0.01 几乎没有重量. 1.0 会关闭此功能, 恢复原版重量. 此设置永远不会改变物品占用的格数: 占用尺寸始终根据物品的原始重量计算.

groups.en: Percentage chance of a zed being a sprinter. If you use PhunZones, this is the fallback risk level when no other value is specified by a zone (or its parent). Examples: 0 = no chance. 50 = 50%% chance and 100 = always
groups.ch: 殭屍成為跑屍的百分比機率. 若使用 PhunZones, 當區域 (或其上層區域) 未指定其他數值時, 以此作為備用風險等級. 例: 0 = 不會, 50 = 50%% 機率, 100 = 必定.
groups.cn: 僵尸成为跑尸的百分比概率. 若使用 PhunZones, 当区域 (或其上层区域) 未指定其他数值时, 以此作为后备风险等级. 例: 0 = 不会, 50 = 50%% 概率, 100 = 必定.

groups.en: The number of hours (across all characters) until risk level is fully applied. For example, if this value is 240 (10 game days) then on the fifth day of play (regardless of how many times they have died), the effective risk that a player is reduced by 50%. Leave blank or 0 to ignore
groups.ch: 所有角色累計遊玩時數達到此值前, 風險等級不會完全套用. 例如設為240 (10遊戲天) 時, 在遊玩第五天 (不論死亡幾次), 玩家的實際風險會減少50%%. 留空或填0則忽略.
groups.cn: 所有角色累计游玩时长达到此值前, 风险等级不会完全生效. 例如设为240 (10游戏天) 时, 在游玩第五天 (无论死亡几次), 玩家的实际风险会减少50%%. 留空或填0则忽略.

groups.en: The number of hours (across all characters) until risk level is fully applied. For example, if this value is 240 (10 game days) then on the fifth day of play (regardless of how many times they have died), the effective risk that a player is reduced by 50%%. Leave blank or 0 to ignore

groups.cn: 所有角色累计游玩时长达到此值前, 风险等级不会完全生效. 例如设为240 (10游戏天) 时, 在游玩第五天 (无论死亡几次), 玩家的实际风险会减少50%%. 留空或填0则忽略.

groups.cn: 控制跑尸何时启动奔跑. ** = 性能占用低, *** = 根据僵尸数量中高占用

groups.ch: 跑屍狀態切換提示音量
groups.cn: 跑尸状态切换提示音量

groups.en: Volume of the sound that notifies players that sprinters are no longer running (eg day) or that they have now started to run (eg night or bad weather). Set to 0 to disable
groups.ch: 通知玩家跑屍已停止奔跑 (例如白天) 或已開始奔跑 (例如夜晚或惡劣天氣) 的提示音效音量. 設為0可關閉
groups.cn: 通知玩家跑尸已停止奔跑 (例如白天) 或已开始奔跑 (例如夜晚或恶劣天气) 的提示音效音量. 设为0可关闭

groups.en: Volume of the sound that plays when conditions change: sprinting becomes possible (eg dusk, or bad weather) or stops being possible (eg dawn). It announces the conditions, not any particular zed. With Slow in light, or the tile based mode, a zed also has to be somewhere dark before it actually runs, so this can sound a while before you see anything running. Set to 0 to disable.
groups.ch: 條件改變時播放的提示音效音量: 變得可以奔跑 (例如黃昏或惡劣天氣) 或不再能奔跑 (例如黎明). 它提示的是條件, 而不是任何特定的殭屍. 使用「光亮減速效果」或格子模式時, 殭屍還必須身處黑暗處才會真的奔跑, 所以提示音響起後可能要過一陣子才會看到有跑屍在跑. 設為0可關閉.
groups.cn: 条件改变时播放的提示音效音量: 变得可以奔跑 (例如黄昏或恶劣天气) 或不再能奔跑 (例如黎明). 它提示的是条件, 而不是任何特定的僵尸. 使用“光亮减速效果”或格子模式时, 僵尸还必须身处黑暗处才会真正奔跑, 所以提示音响起后可能要过一阵子才会看到有跑尸在跑. 设为0可关闭.

groups.en: The number of seconds between scanning for zone changes. Higher number is easier on the server
groups.ch: 兩次掃描區域變化之間的秒數. 數值越高, 伺服器負擔越低.
groups.cn: 两次扫描区域变化之间的秒数. 数值越高, 服务器负担越低.

groups.en: The number of seconds between scanning for zone changes. 1 should be more than fine
groups.ch: 兩次掃描區域變化之間的秒數. 設為 1 應該就綽綽有餘了.
groups.cn: 两次扫描区域变化之间的秒数. 设为 1 应该就绰绰有余了.

groups.cn: 显示 PhunZones 小组件. 可能需要重启客户端才能生效.

groups.en: Displays a moveable widget that displays the current zones title and subtitle. It can also show pips that signify the danger level for the current zone

groups.cn: 显示可移动的小组件, 呈现当前区域的标题与副标题. 也可以用圆点显示当前区域的危险等级.

groups.en:
Bodies will have their age (world hours) multiplied by this value, which is then added to Start Distance.
Any body within this distance will be selected as a possible target.
groups.ch:
屍體的年齡 (世界小時數) 會乘以此值, 再加到起始距離上.
任何在此距離內的屍體都會被列為可能的目標.
groups.cn:
尸体的年龄 (世界小时数) 会乘以此值, 再加到起始距离上.
任何在此距离内的尸体都会被列为可能的目标.

groups.en: Bodies will have their age (world hours) multiplied by this value, which is then added to the smell distance.
groups.ch: 屍體的年齡 (世界小時數) 會乘以此值, 再加到氣味距離上.
groups.cn: 尸体的年龄 (世界小时数) 会乘以此值, 再加到气味距离上.

groups.en:
This angle is used to determine whether a zombie falls inside an area that is projected from bodies in the direction of the wind, up to a distance of [Start Distance + Age Multiplier + Wind Speed Multiplier].
Set to 0 to disable, causing wind direction to have no effect.
groups.ch:
此角度用於判定殭屍是否位於從屍體順著風向投射出的區域內, 範圍最遠為 [起始距離 + 腐爛時間係數 + 風速係數].
設為 0 則停用, 風向將不產生影響.
groups.cn:
此角度用于判定僵尸是否位于从尸体顺着风向投射出的区域内, 范围最远为 [起始距离 + 腐烂时间系数 + 风速系数].
设为 0 则禁用, 风向将不产生影响.
groups._note: 括號內名稱照同 MOD 沙盒標籤 (腐爛時間係數/風速係數)

groups.en:
This angle is used to determine whether a zombie falls inside an area that is projected from bodies in the direction of the wind, up to the smell distance.
Set to 0 to disable.
groups.ch:
此角度用於判定殭屍是否位於從屍體順著風向投射出的區域內, 範圍最遠為氣味距離.
設為 0 則停用.
groups.cn:
此角度用于判定僵尸是否位于从尸体顺着风向投射出的区域内, 范围最远为气味距离.
设为 0 则禁用.

groups.en: Any body further than this distance from a zombie will never be selected as a target.
groups.ch: 與殭屍距離超過此值的屍體永遠不會被選為目標.
groups.cn: 与僵尸距离超过此值的尸体永远不会被选为目标.

groups.en: Maximum potential distance of dead body smell
groups.ch: 屍體氣味可能達到的最大距離
groups.cn: 尸体气味可能达到的最大距离

groups.en: Any body within this distance from a zombie will always be selected as a possible target.
groups.ch: 與殭屍距離在此值以內的屍體一律會被列為可能的目標.
groups.cn: 与僵尸距离在此值以内的尸体一律会被列为可能的目标.

groups.en: Body smell distance will always start at this value.
groups.ch: 屍體氣味距離一律從此值開始.
groups.cn: 尸体气味距离总是从此值开始.

groups.en: The current wind speed (km/h) is multiplied by this value, which is then added to the result of [Start Distance + Age Multiplier].
groups.ch: 目前風速 (km/h) 會乘以此值, 再加到 [起始距離 + 腐爛時間係數] 的結果上.
groups.cn: 当前风速 (km/h) 会乘以此值, 再加到 [起始距离 + 腐烂时间系数] 的结果上.

groups.en:
This value is used to determine how much impact the wind speed has on the smell of bodies.
Higher values increase the effect.
Wind has a significant impact on smell distance.
groups.ch:
此值用於決定風速對屍體氣味的影響程度.
數值越高, 影響越大.
風對氣味距離有顯著影響.
groups.cn:
此值用于决定风速对尸体气味的影响程度.
数值越高, 影响越大.
风对气味距离有显著影响.

groups.en: The amount of blood on a player, and on items in their inventory, will be multiplied by this value, which is then added to Start Distance.
groups.ch: 玩家身上的血跡及其物品欄中的血跡會乘以此值, 並加到起始距離上.
groups.cn: 玩家身上的血迹及其物品栏中的血迹会乘以此值, 并加到起始距离上.

groups.en: The amount of blood on a player, and on items in their inventory, will be multiplied by this value, which is then added to smell distance.
groups.ch: 玩家身上的血跡及其物品欄中的血跡會乘以此值, 並加到氣味距離上.
groups.cn: 玩家身上的血迹及其物品栏中的血迹会乘以此值, 并加到气味距离上.

groups.en:
This angle is used to determine whether a zombie falls inside an area that is projected from players in the direction of the wind, up to a distance of [Start Distance + Blood Multiplier + Wind Speed Multiplier].
Set to 0 disable, causing wind direction to have no effect.
groups.ch:
此角度用於判定殭屍是否位於從玩家順著風向投射出的區域內, 範圍最遠為 [起始距離 + 血跡係數 + 風速係數].
設為 0 則停用, 風向將不產生影響.
groups.cn:
此角度用于判定僵尸是否位于从玩家顺着风向投射出的区域内, 范围最远为 [起始距离 + 血迹系数 + 风速系数].
设为 0 则禁用, 风向将不产生影响.

groups.en:
This angle is used to determine whether a zombie falls inside an area that is projected from players in the direction of the wind, up to the smell distance.

groups.en:
<RGB:1,1,1>The chance for each round type to
drop from a zombie you kill.

Every type you turn on is checked on
its own, and most zombies are
checked twice. With all 9 types on,
that is 18 checks per body.

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>So 5 does not mean 5%% of zombies.
Many small chances add up. At 5 you
get ammo from about 60%% of bodies.

<RGB:1.000,0.700,0.200>A gun pack's Ammo Loot Drop can be
on at the same time. This mod owns
the vanilla rounds then and the pack
mod drops only its own, so nothing
lands twice. Real Firearms is the
one that cannot be on with this.

<RGB:0.800,1.000,0.000>Try 20 if you want almost every
zombie to drop ammo. Raise it
slowly.

<RGB:1,1,1>Set it to 0 to stop the drop.
groups.ch:
<RGB:1,1,1>你擊殺的殭屍掉落每種子彈的機率.

每個開啟的種類各自擲骰, 多數殭屍會擲兩次.
9 種全開就是每具 18 次.

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>所以 5 不是 5%% 的殭屍會掉.
許多小機率會累加起來. 設為 5 時,
約 60%% 的屍體會掉落彈藥.

<RGB:1.000,0.700,0.200>槍械包的彈藥掉落可以同時開啟. 此時原版子彈
由本模組負責, 槍械包只掉落自己的, 不會重複掉落.
唯獨 Real Firearms 不能與本模組同時啟用.

<RGB:0.800,1.000,0.000>若想讓幾乎每隻殭屍都掉落彈藥, 可試試 20.
請慢慢調高.

<RGB:1,1,1>設為 0 即關閉掉落.
groups.cn:
<RGB:1,1,1>你击杀的僵尸掉落每种子弹的几率.

每个开启的种类各自掷骰, 多数僵尸会掷两次.
9 种全开就是每具 18 次.

<RGB:0.100,0.800,1.000>所以 5 不是 5%% 的僵尸会掉.
许多小几率会累加起来. 设为 5 时,
约 60%% 的尸体会掉落弹药.

<RGB:1.000,0.700,0.200>枪械包的弹药掉落可以同时开启. 此时原版子弹
由本模组负责, 枪械包只掉落自己的, 不会重复掉落.
唯独 Real Firearms 不能与本模组同时启用.

<RGB:0.800,1.000,0.000>若想让几乎每只僵尸都掉落弹药, 可试试 20.
请慢慢调高.

<RGB:1,1,1>设为 0 即关闭掉落.

groups.en:
/AAAAFFAlways/FFFFFF: Zombies will always attack objects in their path.
/AAAAFFIndoors/FFFFFF: Zombies considered indoors will attack objects in their path.
/AAAAFFNever/FFFFFF: Zombies will not attack objects in their path.
/AAAAFFRandom/FFFFFF: Randomly select one of the above, when the period of activity is calculated.

The vanilla destruction settings do NOT have an effect on this setting.
Setting this value to /FF0000anything other than /AAAAFFNever /FF0000increases difficulty/FFFFFF.

Recommended setting is /AAAAFFAlways/FFFFFF:
- It increases the ambiance.
- It makes undamaged houses valuable.
- It opens more paths for zombies to use.
groups.ch:
/AAAAFF總是/FFFFFF: 殭屍總是會攻擊行進路線上的物體.
/AAAAFF室內/FFFFFF: 被判定為在室內的殭屍會攻擊行進路線上的物體.
/AAAAFF從不/FFFFFF: 殭屍不會攻擊行進路線上的物體.
/AAAAFF隨機/FFFFFF: 計算活動時段時, 從以上選項中隨機選擇一個.

原版的破壞設定「不會」影響此設定.
將此值設為/FF0000除了/AAAAFF從不/FF0000以外的任何選項都會提高難度/FFFFFF.

推薦設定為/AAAAFF總是/FFFFFF:
- 增加氛圍.
- 讓未受損的房屋更有價值.
- 為殭屍開闢更多可走的路徑.
groups.cn:
/AAAAFF总是/FFFFFF: 僵尸总是会攻击行进路线上的物体.
/AAAAFF室内/FFFFFF: 被判定为在室内的僵尸会攻击行进路线上的物体.
/AAAAFF从不/FFFFFF: 僵尸不会攻击行进路线上的物体.
/AAAAFF随机/FFFFFF: 计算活动时段时, 从以上选项中随机选择一个.

原版的破坏设置“不会”影响此设置.
将此值设为/FF0000除了/AAAAFF从不/FF0000以外的任何选项都会提高难度/FFFFFF.

推荐设置为/AAAAFF总是/FFFFFF:
- 增加氛围.
- 让未受损的房屋更有价值.
- 为僵尸开辟更多可走的路径.
groups._note: /RRGGBB 色碼照 EN 數量保留；紅字「除了…以外」語序重排

groups.en: Oral antifungal medication. <LINE> CURES corpse sickness. <LINE> Treatment time: 5 days.

groups.cn: 口服抗真菌药物. <LINE> 治愈尸体病. <LINE> 治疗时间: 5 天.

groups.en: Oral antifungal medication. <LINE> CURES cadaveric aspergillosis. <LINE> Treatment time: 5 days.

groups.en: Antiparasitic medication. <LINE> CURES parasitic infections (trichinosis, hyperkeratotic scabies). <LINE> Treatment time: 7 days.

groups.en: Topical antiseptic cream. <LINE> Apply to wounds to prevent infection. <LINE> 25% infection reduction. Does NOT cure established infections.

groups.en: Prescription antiseptic cream. <LINE> Apply to active wounds to prevent infection. <LINE> 100%% wound infection prevention while active. Does NOT cure established infections.

groups.en: Archery component. Assemble arrows and crossbow bolts in Crafting > Weaponry. Each needs a matching shaft, a head, three fletchings and one use of glue.

groups.en: Underbarrel grenade launcher. Attach to a compatible firearm; switch with the Gunworks underbarrel key (U by default), then reload and fire.

groups.cn: 作为固定式减后坐力配件. 不支持展开架设.

groups.en:
Appears to be a basic chemistry book, but filled with handwritten notes on unstable reagents used in the lab.
Doesn't seem like something that should be in circulation.
groups.ch:
看起來像一本基礎化學書, 但寫滿了關於實驗室所用不穩定試劑的手寫筆記.
似乎不是應該在市面上流通的東西.
groups.cn:
看起来像一本基础化学书, 但写满了关于实验室所用不稳定试剂的手写笔记.
似乎不是应该在市面上流通的东西.

groups.ch: 給對化學有興趣的人看的小手冊.
groups.cn: 给对化学感兴趣的人看的小手册.

groups.ch: 建造科學裝飾品的手冊.

groups.cn: 制作直观教具与海报的实用指南.

groups.cn: 操作实验室熔炉的完整指南.

groups.en: Place using the inventory context menu. Proximity: 5-second arming delay, sensor radius 3. Timer: 10 seconds by default. Remote: link a remote controller before placing. Change mode in Crafting > Weaponry; changing mode clears the controller link and custom timer.
groups.ch: 從物品欄右鍵選單放置. 感應: 5 秒啟動延遲, 感應半徑 3. 定時: 預設 10 秒. 遙控: 放置前先連結遙控器. 在「製作 > 兵器」中切換模式; 切換模式會清除遙控器連結與自訂計時.
groups.cn: 从物品栏右键菜单放置. 感应: 5 秒启动延迟, 感应半径 3. 定时: 默认 10 秒. 遥控: 放置前先连接遥控器. 在“制作 > 兵器”中切换模式; 切换模式会清除遥控器连接与自定义计时.

groups.en:
Legacy launcher: while aiming, press Launch Attached Device (default G) to load when empty or fire when loaded.
New MFS launcher: press Toggle Grenade Launcher Mode (default G), then use normal reload and fire controls. Bindings can be changed in Key Settings.
groups.ch:
舊式發射器: 瞄準時按「發射附掛裝置」(預設 G), 未裝填時裝填, 已裝填時發射.
MFS 新式發射器: 按「切換榴彈發射器模式」(預設 G), 再用一般的裝填與射擊操作. 可在按鍵設定中變更按鍵.
groups.cn:
旧式发射器: 瞄准时按“发射下挂装置”(默认 G), 未装填时装填, 已装填时发射.
MFS 新式发射器: 按“切换榴弹发射器模式”(默认 G), 然后使用常规的装填和射击操作. 可在按键设置中更改按键绑定.

groups.en: A heavy gun barrel. A longer barrel gives you more damage, longer range, and a reduces recoil more. The thicker barrel reduces it further. The downside is it takes longer to get on target, so it's not idea of close quarters. Required for the gun to fire.
groups.ch: 重型槍管. 較長的槍管可提高傷害, 增加射程, 並減少更多後坐力; 較粗的槍管能再進一步減少後坐力. 缺點是需要更久才能瞄準目標, 因此不適合近身戰鬥. 槍械必須裝有此零件才能開火.

groups.en: Salvaging vehicles with a Welding Mask and Propane Torch will remove them from your path. Vehicle Salvage takes longer to complete and uses more propane than Dismantle Car Wreck but gives extra items and higher XP. <LINE> Higher Metalwork skills will retrieve more usable salvage. <LINE> *Hint remove vehicle parts first and empty the trunk.
groups.ch: 佩戴焊接面罩並使用丙烷噴燈拆解回收車輛, 可將擋路的車輛移除. 車輛拆解回收比拆除汽車殘骸耗時更長, 消耗更多丙烷, 但能產出額外物品並獲得更多經驗值. <LINE> 金工技能等級越高, 回收的可用材料就越多. <LINE> *提示: 先拆下車輛零件並清空後車廂.
groups.cn: 佩戴焊工面罩并使用丙烷喷灯拆解回收车辆, 可将挡路的车辆移除. 车辆拆解回收比拆解汽车残骸耗时更长, 消耗更多丙烷, 但能产出额外物品并获得更多经验值. <LINE> 金工技能等级越高, 回收的可用材料就越多. <LINE> *提示: 先拆下车辆零件并清空后备箱.
groups._note: Dismantle Car Wreck 是本體右鍵選單名，本體 CH ContextMenu_RemoveBurntVehicle 為「拆除汽車殘骸」(CN 本來就是「拆解汽车残骸」)；Welding Mask 照本體 CH 物品名 Base.WeldingMask「焊接面罩」(corpus 19 比 11)

groups.en: Salvaging vehicles with a welding mask and propane torch will destroy them, and provide metalworking materials. Higher Welding skills will retrieve more usable salvage.
groups.ch: 佩戴焊接面罩並使用丙烷噴燈拆解回收車輛, 會將車輛摧毀, 並提供金工材料. 金工技能等級越高, 回收的可用材料就越多.
groups.cn: 佩戴焊工面罩并使用丙烷喷灯拆解回收车辆, 会将车辆摧毁, 并提供金工材料. 金工技能等级越高, 回收的可用材料就越多.
groups._note: welding mask 照本體 CH 物品名「焊接面罩」，與 g0 一致

groups.cn: 要是这玩意把我变成丧尸, 我一定要投诉!

groups.en: They used this on people and didn’t ask twice.
groups.ch: 他們直接拿這東西用在人身上, 連問都沒多問一句.
groups.cn: 他们直接拿这东西用在人身上, 连问都没多问一句.

groups.en: A little boost to keep me going.
groups.ch: 一點小小的提升, 足夠讓我繼續撐下去.
groups.cn: 一点小小的提升, 足够让我继续撑下去.

groups.en: Something’s moving. I can feel it.
groups.ch: 有東西在動. 我感覺得到.
groups.cn: 有东西在动. 我感觉得到.

groups.en: I feel a bit stronger now.
groups.ch: 我現在感覺稍微強壯了一些.
groups.cn: 我现在感觉稍微强壮了一些.

groups.ch: 太快了… 實在太快了.
groups.cn: 太快了… 实在太快了.

groups.en: Hopefully this helps me heal up.
groups.ch: 希望這能幫我恢復傷勢.
groups.cn: 希望这能帮我恢复伤势.

groups.en: This isn’t how the body’s supposed to work.
groups.ch: 身體不該是這樣運作的.
groups.cn: 身体不该是这样运作的.

groups.ch: 在這種地方, 必須得保持健康.
groups.cn: 在这种地方, 必须得保持健康.

groups.en: These should help with my wounds.
groups.ch: 這些應該能幫我的傷口恢復.
groups.cn: 这些应该能帮我的伤口恢复.

groups.en: God, what did they put in this…
groups.ch: 天啊, 他們到底在這裡面加了什麼…
groups.cn: 天哪, 他们到底在这里面加了什么…

groups.en: I think I'm starting to feel better.
groups.ch: 我覺得自己開始好起來了.
groups.cn: 我觉得自己开始好起来了.

groups.en: Feels like it’s forcing me back together.
groups.ch: 感覺它在硬把我拼回原樣.
groups.cn: 感觉它在硬把我拼回原样.

groups.en: Need water… feels like I’m drying out.
groups.ch: 需要水… 感覺整個人快乾掉了.
groups.cn: 需要水… 感觉整个人快干掉了.

groups.ch: <CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> <RGB:1,0.75,0.25> 房車已改用車輛框架 <LINE> <LINE> <LEFT> <SIZE:small> <RGB:1,1,1> 遊牧者房車與戴爾的酋長房車現在改由 DeadWorks Vehicle Framework 運作. 每輛房車及其中的一切, 包括家具、冰箱、櫥櫃、水和電池, 都會在第一次載入時轉換. <LINE> 這應該會自動完成, 但請保留這次更新前的備份, 以防出錯. <LINE>  <LINE> <RGB:1,0.75,0.25> 如何備份 <RGB:1,1,1> <LINE> 1. 退回主選單. <LINE> 2. 開啟你的 <RGB:0.55,0.85,1> Zomboid <RGB:1,1,1> 資料夾, 在 Windows 上通常是 <RGB:0.55,0.85,1> C:/Users/你的使用者名稱/Zomboid <RGB:1,1,1> <LINE> 3. 把 <RGB:0.55,0.85,1> Saves <RGB:1,1,1> 資料夾複製到安全的地方. <LINE> 若要復原, 把這份副本放回去, 並改回上一個版本. <LINE>  <LINE> <CENTRE> <RGB:0.6,0.6,0.6> 這則訊息只會顯示一次.
